utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep spreading the word and make sure everyone knows when to show up for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I’ll pass that along too. Good to know you’ve got the timing covered.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: You got it — I’ll keep sharing the time so everyone’s in the loop for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Sam — the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center, and I’m lining up the list and volunteers for that day.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — I can help Sunday at the community center. Let me know what task you’d like me to take on first.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Sam — could you start with the tool check-in and greet folks as they arrive? I’ll send you the updated list shortly.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Faye — I’ll be there tomorrow at 3:30, and we can start with the donations and then make the parts list.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect—tomorrow at 3:30 works, and we’ll start with the donations first, then the parts list.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great, that plan works for me. I’ll see you tomorrow at 3:30, and we can sort the donations first.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Vik — could you repeat the timing and transport plan once more? I want to make sure I’ve got everything straight.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure — the timing is still the same, and I’ll confirm who’s handling the transport so you can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks — can you confirm the exact pickup time and who’s driving? I just want to make sure the transport is settled.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sure, I can take a look at the back gate hinge first.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good—can you also check the latch and tell me what parts we’ll need?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes, I’ll check the latch too and let you know what parts we need.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, good to hear — I’m glad it’s picking up fast. If anything new comes up, just let me know and I’ll keep passing it along.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Will do — I’ll let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Bo — I appreciate it. I’ll keep an ear out and pass along anything I hear.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I’ll keep an eye on the timing and transport. Just remind me if I wander off, and I’ll do my best to stay on it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’d be great, Oren. If you can check those and keep me posted, I can sort the rest without worrying about the logistics.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Absolutely — I’ll check the timing and transport and keep you posted. If I go quiet, give me a nudge and I’ll get right back on it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just checking—you’re sure it’s still on for today, right?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes, it’s still on for today. See you there.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, just wanted to confirm.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I’ll start on the hall faucet now and we can keep the repair drive moving.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, thank you—once you’re done, I’ll line up the next fix for us.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great — I’ll check the faucet first and let you know when it’s ready for the next fix.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ll do that, Rosa — I’ll bring my notes back so we can compare them and prioritize the repairs. I’ve got the update too: it’s Sunday at the community center now.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Rey — thanks for keeping up with the update. Bring your notes to the community center on Sunday, and we’ll sort the repairs together.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it, Rosa — I’ll bring my notes to the community center on Sunday and we’ll sort the repairs together.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’m checking with the other groups now, and I’ll tell you exactly what’s coming so we can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Good — you’re sure it’s still happening today, right?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yes — it’s still on for today, and I’m confirming the exact donations now so we know what to expect.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m on it—I’ll swing by the usual spot and see what I can find on the repair drive. If anything’s missing, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Ira — that’d be a huge help. I’ll send the list over as soon as I’ve checked in with the other groups.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good, Jules—I’ll check the usual spot while I’m out and keep an eye out for anything missing. Send the list when you can, and I’ll report back right away.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You got it, Hana — I’ll bring the screwdriver set, flashlight, and a small wrench if I can find one. See you at the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Gus — that sounds perfect. See you at the repair drive!

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You bet, Hana — I’ll see you there with the tools.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. Just point me to the donations table when I get there, and I’ll keep an eye on the tool sign-out sheet too.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — thanks, Mara. I’ll point you to the donations table at the community center this Saturday afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect — I’ll head to the community center this Saturday afternoon and check in at the desk if I can’t find you right away.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Bo — we could use extra screwdrivers, gloves, and some rags if you have them. Dane, no rush; I’ll keep a spot open for you when you get here.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Cleo — I’ll swing by a bit late, but I can bring some extra screwdrivers and gloves if I have them.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That’d be great, Dane — screwdrivers and gloves are exactly what we need. Just come when you can, and I’ll keep your spot ready.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — can you bring the bikes and any small appliances that still look worth fixing?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yep, I’ll bring the bikes and any small appliances that still seem fixable. I’ll double-check by Friday and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, that helps. Let me know by Friday what you’ve got, and I’ll make sure we have room for it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks — I’ve got it as the community center parking lot on Maple after 3. If you send the exact spot from the notice, I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect—I’ll send the exact spot as soon as I grab it, and I’ll spread the word to a few more neighbors too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sounds good—send the exact spot when you have it, and I’ll pass it along too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, Uli — I’ve got the pile by the shed, and I’ll show you the bits that still work.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sure, Tess—just point me to the pile and I’ll start sorting what still works.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Uli — I really appreciate it. I’ll point you to the pile and we can get this repair drive moving along.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Opal — I’d appreciate that. I probably glanced right past it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It’s by the community center, in the north lot near the blue mailbox.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, got it — the north lot by the community center and blue mailbox. Thanks, I must’ve walked right past that sign.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ll put you down and meet you at the community center parking lot on Maple after 3.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good — I’ll meet you at the community center parking lot on Maple after 3.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, thanks Rey — I’ll see you there after 3!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Tess — I’ll look out for the updated list and be ready to help at the community center on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Sam — I’ll get the updated list to you soon so you can have it ready for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Tess — I’ll keep an eye out and be ready to help on Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, I’ll come by after drop-off and we can start with whatever needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect — I’ll have the screwdriver set and flashlight ready, and we can start with whatever needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good — I’ll head over after drop-off and we can tackle the first repairs together.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Eli, I’m on my way to the garage now — see you in a few minutes.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great, Dane — when you get here, please start with the donations table and I’ll point you to the next job.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’m heading to the donations table now.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — what time and place should I check first for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Check the church hall at 10 a.m. first — that’s where the repair drive is starting.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it — church hall at 10 a.m. first. Thanks, Ira; I’ll check there.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I can grab tape, zip ties, and check for a hammer and screwdriver set. If you spot anything else we’re missing, just add it to the list.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I’ll add anything else I find to the list and keep an eye out for missing supplies.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect — I’ll bring those by and keep it moving.
